assets.name: account-avatar-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one polished small UI illustration for the Russian daily puzzle game Shoditsa. Style: friendly hand-drawn game sticker, thick rounded near-black ink outlines with slight organic irregularity, simple bold silhouettes and flat pastel color fills, restrained two-tone cel highlights. Palette: warm ivory #fff8e6, lavender #c5aff0, mint #c8ead7, soft gold #ffe39a, ink #181919. It must belong to the same visual family as a cream ink-outlined game controller and a lilac-and-yellow treasure chest. Not a stock line icon. No glossy 3D, gradients, blur, cast shadow, typography, lettering, watermark, owl or green monster. Isolated on genuine transparent background, alpha preserved, tight centered composition with all edges fully visible and about 10% padding. Asset type: compact guest account avatar, readable at 32px. Subject: a cheerful gender-neutral illustrated human bust, round warm-ivory face, simple two black dot eyes and a small smile, short rounded lavender hair, mint shirt. Head and shoulders only, warm welcoming expression, no enclosing card or circular frame, no extra surrounding objects. Big simple shapes.

assets.name: settings-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single compact illustrated settings icon for the daily puzzle app Shoditsa. Subject: one friendly rounded lavender gear with six broad chunky teeth, a warm ivory circular center, a tiny mint adjustment slider inset across the middle, and one restrained soft-gold highlight. It should clearly read as settings at 24 to 36 pixels. Style must match an illustrated cream player ID card and a hand-inked cream game controller: thick rounded near-black ink outlines, slight organic line irregularity, flat pastel colors, simple bold silhouette, no fine detail. Palette: lavender #c5aff0, warm ivory #fff8e6, mint #c8ead7, soft gold #ffe39a, ink #181919. Isolated, centered, genuinely transparent background with alpha, tight framing and about 8 percent safe padding. No character, no face, no owl, no green monster, no lettering, no text, no border frame, no cast shadow, no gradients, no blur, no glossy 3D. A polished bespoke game UI illustration, not a generic thin line stock icon.
